say:0:1120724001:0.text: Luckily, Rumon was saved by his friend...
say:0:1120724001:0.source_cn: 卢玛被他的朋友救走了！幸好……

say:1:1120724002:0.text: I've never heard of any Quicksand Claws coming to Alkali!
say:1:1120724002:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪竟然会来到咸水镇，这可从没听说过！

say:2:1120724003:0.text: We'll have to see about their recent status. By the way, let's ask about candidates for the Bestial Brawl.
say:2:1120724003:0.source_cn: 有必要打听一下他们的近况。顺便问一下斗兽演祀的人选吧。
